claims_boundary: Empirical comparisons of ASPIRE and CaP-X evaluate their published development/execution protocols adapted onto the shared host SDK under matched model and budget, not their upstream perception/motion stacks. RoboRepair is explicitly marked as a protocol reimplementation because no official repository was verified. Evidence is simulation-only and is NOT physical-robot or food-quality certification.

literature_matrix.independent_acceptance_rollback: Dev/unseen/heldout split; no fixed-version release/rollback registry
literature_matrix.perception_control_separation: Partial (upstream stack couples SAM3/GraspNet/cuRobo; Appendix E allows perception tweaks)

literature_matrix.eval_time_llm_calls: >=1 online regen turns per failed trial
literature_matrix.independent_acceptance_rollback: Frequency-based SkillLibrary auto-promotion; no acceptance gate
literature_matrix.perception_control_separation: Tier-dependent (S1 privileged GT; S2 perception + high-level APIs)
literature_matrix.unknown_ack_reconciliation: Not modeled (multi-turn regen on un-reset episode risks duplicate actuation)

literature_matrix.code_availability: Project page only (controller code not verified public)
literature_matrix.independent_acceptance_rollback: Offline dev -> frozen eval; highlights reset/demo cost accounting
literature_matrix.perception_control_separation: Yes (runtime observations consumed by frozen code)

literature_matrix.eval_time_llm_calls: >=1 online trace-guided repair call on error
literature_matrix.independent_acceptance_rollback: Online recovery only; no offline release governance
literature_matrix.perception_control_separation: Abstract service-robot API (no continuous manipulation safety gates)
literature_matrix.redline_false_actuation_gate: Trace constraints on critical action count; single error per task
literature_matrix.unknown_ack_reconciliation: Handles known errors/interruptions; uncertain device effects open

literature_matrix.independent_acceptance_rollback: Confidence threshold calibration; no release/rollback registry
literature_matrix.perception_control_separation: Symbolic PDDL/SMT + active recursive probe policies
literature_matrix.unknown_ack_reconciliation: Active observation probes for incomplete state; no idempotency journal

literature_matrix.independent_acceptance_rollback: Locked independent acceptance + fixed-version ReleaseRegistry & rollback
literature_matrix.perception_control_separation: Strict (read-only EvidenceScene owner, policy engine, host actuation)
literature_matrix.portability_static_check: Enforced AST coordinate portability & sandbox preflight gate
literature_matrix.redline_false_actuation_gate: Explicit Tier-3 False-Actuation Rate + Failure-to-Testcase regression gate
literature_matrix.unknown_ack_reconciliation: Intent-before-dispatch Journal + query-first reconciliation (0 duplicate brews)
